description_en: Queries the history of prefix routes for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）前缀路由的历史记录
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefixHistory

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID to load into the Express Connect Router (ECR).

You must specify either the InstanceId parameter or the AssociationId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关加载的实例ID。

InstanceId参数和AssociationId参数必须输入一个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:
VPC: VPC instance.
TR: Transit router instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VPC：虚拟专有网络实例。
TR：转发路由器实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether it is only a dry run for this request. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run for the request without modifying EPS resources.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the VPC or transit router (TR) associated with the Express Connect Router (ECR) for forward routing.

You must specify either the InstanceId parameter or the AssociationId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关与专有网络VPC或转发路由器TR的关联的实例ID。

InstanceId参数和AssociationId参数必须输入一个
parameters.name: association_id

GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建历史路由条目的时间
